main_text.head: SCVTVM REGIVM.
CAP. I. De atrocitate Homicidij.
main_text.p: TRIBVSGen.9. Levit.17. Act.15.{a} diversis temporibus, ante Legem Mosis, in Lege Mosis,& tempore Legis Evangelicæ, sub initium nascentis Ecclesiæ, vetitum esse sanguinis esum legimus; quo vehementius scilicet homines (ut rectè interpretatur antiquitas) ab humani sanguinis effusione deterrerentur. Nec mirum certè, cùm tanta sit hujus peccati enormitas, ut interGen. 18. Exod.3. Iud. 5.{b} quatuor clamantia peccata in sacris codicibus, primum locum teneat; & post ipsum originale secundum.{c} Vox sanguinis, fra-Gen.4.

page.notes: The drop-cap initial is a woodcut T, joined to "RIBVS" as "TRIBVS". The page number "I" is at the top right. The reference letters a, b and c are in the text and in the margin. The running head "Scutum Regum" is faint in places. "versis", "Mosis" and "esse" are read with plain s for long s. The text "fra-" and the catchword "tris" are read from the printed line ends. The line "Vox sanguinis, fra-" is printed in italic. Some lines in the middle of the text are faint and were read with care, but none is marked as illegible.
